[SWS_EM_01014] Scheduling policy
⌈
Execution Management
shall configure the
process scheduling policy (when launching a
process
) based on the relevant config-
uration
StartupConfig
.
schedulingPolicy

For the detailed definitions of these policies, refer to [12]. Note,
SCHED_OTHER
shall be
treated as non real-time scheduling policy, and actual behavior of the policy is imple-
mentation specific. It should not be assumed that the scheduling behavior is compatible
between different
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
implementations, except that it is
a non real-time scheduling policy in a given implementation.
